usageNotes: Use this to update an existing PDM user's profile fields (name, email, comment), enable/disable the account, or set an expiration date. A user can update their own account without elevated privileges; modifying other users requires Access.Modify on /access/users. Use the 'delete' array to clear optional fields (e.g. email or comment) rather than setting them to empty strings.

examples.summary: Disable a user account and set an expiration date

tips: The 'digest' field can be supplied (SHA256 of current config) to guard against concurrent modifications — retrieve it from the corresponding GET /access/users/{userid} response.
Setting 'expire' to 0 removes any expiration date; omitting the field leaves the existing value unchanged.
Password changes via this endpoint apply only to users in the 'pve' realm — users authenticated via LDAP/AD must have passwords changed in the upstream directory.
To clear an optional field entirely, pass its name in the 'delete' array instead of setting it to an empty string.
